name: io.github.whatevercat-creator/crypto-sentiment-x402
description: Real-time crypto sentiment for a ticker symbol from 8 news RSS feeds and the Fear & Greed Index

environmentVariables.name: CDP_API_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Coinbase Developer Platform API key ID (portal.cdp.coinbase.com). Used to sign x402 payments from your own wallet.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_API_KEY_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Coinbase Developer Platform API key secret, paired with CDP_API_KEY_ID.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_WALLET_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Name of the CDP wallet to create/reuse for payments. Defaults to "crypto-sentiment-mcp-wallet". Must hold USDC (+ a little ETH for gas) on the configured network.

environmentVariables.name: SENTIMENT_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the deployed sentiment API. Defaults to https://crypto-sentiment-x402.onrender.com.

environmentVariables.name: X402_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: "mainnet" (default, real USDC on Base) or "testnet" (free Base Sepolia USDC).
